broken: GlitchTip does not symbolicate an obfuscated Flutter Android frame: the throw-site frame comes back with function=null, file=null, line=null, so every Flutter Android line number and function name GlitchTip displays is unreliable.
until: a GlitchTip release containing upstream MR !2474 ("fix(difs): Use debug_meta image_addr for native symbolication", merged 2026-08-15, in no release as of 2026-09-20) is installed on the box that serves GlitchTip
triageInstead: decode the build's kept symbols-* artifact with the pinned native_stack_traces (tooling/versions.json), never the GlitchTip frame
_why: WHAT THE PROOF ASSERTS IS THE RECORDED STATE, NOT AN IDEAL ONE. This file is that
recorded state, as data. tooling/ops/symbolication-proof.mjs `verdict` READS it on every
run and compares BOTH of its readings against it; nothing here is prose the script
ignores. A register earns JSON only when a guard reads it, and this one was landed in
the same change as its reader.
🔴 WHY A RECORDED-STATE REGISTER AND NOT A RED CHECK. The proof ran five times, each
red; the last one (35470727346) was red for its real FINDING rather than a defect in
itself — GROUND TRUTH matched symbolication_crash_probe.dart:36 and the GlitchTip 6.2.6
SINK frame was unsymbolicated. That finding is now decided: [ADR 090] and row
O-GLITCHTIP-UPGRADE-SYMBOLICATION. A workflow that stays red forever for a fact we have
already decided about teaches its reader to ignore red — the owner sees "Symbolication
proof — deployment failed" and cannot tell it from a real failure. That is precisely
the class docs/verification-discipline.md exists to prevent, so the comparison moved
from an ideal to this record.
🔴 AND A GREEN RUN THEREFORE DOES NOT MEAN SYMBOLICATION WORKS. While `sink` reads
"mismatch", exit 0 means ONLY "reality still equals the record". The verdict prints an
unmissable banner built from `broken`, `until` and `row` on every green run, so the
green can never be read as the capability working. `broken` is therefore load-bearing
text, not a comment: the reader refuses a row whose `broken` is empty.
🔴 THE VERSION IS THE EXPIRY. `evidence.glitchtipVersion` is what the instance reported
from `GET /api/settings/` when this state was measured. The verdict reads that endpoint
LIVE on every run and exits 2 COVERAGE LOST the moment the instance is a different
version, because a record measured against 6.2.6 says nothing about 6.3.0. A stale
expectation that kept passing would be the worst of both worlds: a green check asserting
a fact about software that is no longer installed.
HOW THIS ENDS, IN THIS ORDER: the box gets a GlitchTip release carrying !2474 (Diun /
Renovate announces the image) → the next dispatch exits 2 on the version limb → dispatch
again after setting `evidence` to that run and `evidence.glitchtipVersion` to the new
version → if the sink now MATCHES, set `sink` to "match", close the row and amend
[ADR 090] with the run id. The proof then goes green with no banner, and that green does
mean symbolication works. If instead the sink matches while this file still says
"mismatch", the verdict exits 1 and says exactly that — good news is still a change, and
a change still has to be recorded before the check calls it normal.
